sentence: This project tests a process that helps faculty at liberal arts institutions review and revise their undergraduate computer science curricula.
This project uses airborne ice penetrating radar data to map brine aquifers in Antarctic ice shelves and study how they affect ice shelf stability.
This project studies which genes beetles need to build the prothorax and the hardened forewings, and how these structures evolved.
This project uses topology and geometry to explain how deep learning works, and applies the ideas to cryogenic electron microscopy.
This project designs algorithms that help autonomous systems using sensors such as cameras make safe and reliable decisions while measuring the risk of error.
This project builds a tool that trains deep learning models to map ponds and channel networks in salt marshes from drones, aerial planes, and satellites.
This project builds a digital twin of dynamic construction sites using aerial and ground robots with cameras and radios to monitor progress and worker safety.
This project studies how to measure and improve the safety of graph neural networks when they are trained, adapted, and tested.
This project builds a lensless microscope that uses multiple illumination sources to improve resolution, reduce noise, and watch microscopic organisms in water.
This project studies how the words in real estate advertisements have changed over time and relate to the race and income of likely mortgage applicants.
This project builds robots with robotic skins and morphing limbs that adapt their shape when the environment changes.
This project builds an artificial intelligence system that reads hand-marked paper ballots and flags ballots where its reading differs from the official ballot tabulator.
This project studies how genes and epigenetic changes help sorghum and maize tolerate aluminum toxicity in acidic soils.
This project measures how leaves and twigs on forest floors either shade soil to reduce evaporation or catch rainfall that then evaporates.
This project builds a platform that combines artificial intelligence with digital twins to help people audit homes and design energy retrofits.
This project builds a way to find and sort social media posts in English and other languages where people discuss online security and privacy safeguards.
This project builds a sensor platform powered by AI that tracks heat-related health risks for firefighters and suggests ways to lower them.
This project designs a low-power cryogenic chip to control superconducting qubits and a qubit design that reduces measurement errors.
This project studies how large systems of interacting particles change over time and settle into stable patterns, using mathematical tools.
